name: Ciri's starburst ring
slug: Ciri's unconfirmed ring or bracelet from the white dragon hoard that turns starbursts into fireballs.
description: A ring or bracelet from the white dragon hoard, believed to be in Ciri's possession. It shoots starbursts that turn into fireballs. Its name is unconfirmed.

log.summary: While Ciri is absent, the party tries to remember the hoard item she is believed to be carrying. Dana says it is a ring or bracelet that shoots starbursts which become fireballs. Heard guesses include Nightfall and Starfall, and neither name is confirmed.
notes: A ring or bracelet from the white dragon hoard, believed to be in Ciri's possession. It shoots starbursts that turn into fireballs.
